pattern: には無理がある（にはむりがある）
purpose: Judge a proposal or claim as strained or impractical.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
N / plain clause + には無理がある
Fitting everyone into one vehicle is impractical.
Completing it in two days is unrealistic.
formation: N / plain clause + には無理がある
restrictions: Often softens disagreement with a plan or inference.
mistake: It critiques feasibility or reasoning, not necessarily physical impossibility.
